query:
WITH s AS (SELECT serving_application($1) AS custom)
               SELECT s.custom,
                      EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM guild_presence p
                          WHERE p.guild_id = $1
                            AND p.application_id = COALESCE(s.custom, $2)
                            AND p.left_at IS NULL
                      ) AS "present!"
               FROM s
